### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Steroids are indicated in certain forms of tuberculosis to manage inflammation and prevent complications. In the case of meningitis, steroids are used to reduce inflammation and improve neurological outcomes. For pericarditis, they help decrease pericardial inflammation and lower the risk of constrictive pericarditis. In contrast, steroids are generally not indicated for ileo-caecal tuberculosis due to the risk of exacerbating the infection. In cases of adrenal involvement, steroids are crucial for managing adrenal insufficiency and preventing adrenal crisis. Therefore, the correct answer is ileo-caecal tuberculosis, as steroids are not indicated in this condition.
